verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a search-results API, and a product of this kind could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring searches, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows an async mode, where you submit a search and retrieve it later via the Searches Archive API. That is background processing of a single request the caller starts, not automations that are set up once and run on their own. There is no evidence of scheduling, triggers, recurring jobs or webhooks.
